Afternoon desk rules for pickup lanes
This section covers the routine in plain words

Companion Animal Travel Desk - afternoon pickup and incident handling

Use this section to keep companion animal handoff smooth, calm, and consistent. Staff should greet travelers promptly, check the travel file, and keep language clear and respectful at every step.

When a traveler arrives with a pet carrier, confirm the identity match, inspect the exterior for visible damage, and verify that the carrier remains secured. If the pet appears stressed, slow the pace, lower your voice, and guide the traveler to the nearest safe counter space. Keep the lane free of clutter and do not leave paperwork where it can blow away or be seen by other travelers.

If a reportable issue appears, notify the proper lead at once and keep the conversation focused on facts. <<FACT F108>> Follow the documented path for incident reporting and keep all notes brief, accurate, and free of guesswork. <<FACT F102>> When the pet lounge applies to the route, confirm access status before releasing the animal, and do not send the traveler onward until the handoff is complete. <<FACT F021>> If the traveler needs extra help, provide steady direction and escalate without delay.

Treat every exchange as a service checkpoint for Aurelia Skyways. Do not argue, speculate, or give mixed instructions. If the traveler presents conflicting papers, pause the handoff and resolve the mismatch before continuing. Use plain language, keep the flow orderly, and protect the welfare of the animal and the comfort of the traveler. Luna or any other pet should be handled gently, with secure control and minimal noise.

If you need help with a handoff, a report, or a lounge issue, contact the senior coordinator or the duty desk for direction.
